combo_label: Sandwiches × Morris Dancing × The Jungle Book

entries.clue: Crunchy green leaf, the salad third of a BLT sandwich
Cheese sandwich pressed and browned in a hot two-plate machine
Curved nail a big cat unsheathes when it means harm
Springing leap in a dance, or the sort of frolic a lamb makes
Dark hollow in the rock where Mother Wolf's cubs and the boy were reared
Dripping green wilderness of vine and shadow where the boy grew up
Sandwich in northern English speech, handed over in a paper bag
Shape a sandwich becomes when the knife goes corner to corner
Grey-muzzled leader of the pack, and the name Cub Scouts give their chief
White cloth square, one gripped in each hand, waved through a Cotswold dance
Lame man-eating tiger, sworn foe of the boy the wolves brought up
Call to catch someone's attention, or the move where dancers thread past each other
Leafy roof of the forest, a highway for anything that swings
